family_affinity_concurrency_policy.rationale: Same-family products in a linked multi-PO hub share taxonomy, scorecard thresholds (W-1..W-5, LC-1..LC-6, IS-1..IS-5), cross-domain referral cards, and backlog tags, so they count as ONE unified context with low drift risk. Cross-family concurrency mixes unrelated taxonomies and stays strictly blocked unless Wally explicitly authorizes it.

SHALLOW_SINGLE_PRODUCT_HUB.criteria: Single parent domain, single PO, no sister-domain referral network, minimal cross-domain wiring.

SHALLOW_LINKED_FAMILY.criteria: 2 associated domains with partial shared wiring or single-spoke scope.

STANDARD_LINKED_FAMILY.criteria: Multi-domain linked family sharing taxonomy registry, unified scorecard, and hub PM routing.

DEEP_LINKED_FAMILY.criteria: Multi-domain linked family with (1) canonical non-overlapping URL taxonomy, (2) bidirectional cross-domain Referral Summary Cards, (3) unified 3-spoke Day-0 scorecard (W-1..W-5, LC-1..LC-6, IS-1..IS-5), (4) shared Eleventy/telemetry architecture, and (5) H1-H4 deterministic conflict resolution.

overflow_backlog_products.note: Queued in monthly RDAP/Trends watch; enters active family slot 5/5 upon registration & PO intake.
Queued behind 5-product default cap per linked PM; waits in backlog until an active slot opens or deep-taxonomy cap expansion (6) is activated.

dynamic_leader_chasing_parity_policy.description: Parity across the B2B Cost Audit Family means maintaining a tight spread across all four sister sites (b2bfeeaudit.com, b2bcostaudit.com, saascostaudit.com, apicostaudit.com), where the scheduler and B2B Audit Family PM (9c1c413e) are always in pursuit of whichever product is currently leading at any given moment (rather than targeting a static stage number).
